title: Bakuchi Kadhya Churna
description: Bakuchi Kadhya Churna (Bakuchi Churna) is pure powder of Bakuchi seeds (Psoralea corylifolia), a premier dermatological agent used for centuries in skin treatment. This classical formulation stimulates melanin production to treat leukoderma/vitiligo (white patches on skin) by enhancing natural skin pigmentation. Resolves chronic skin lesions through tissue healing and improved circulation.
dosage: Mixed with water (used both internally and as external paste)
